//: Why a dev client at all (Phase 01 deliverable 4):
Expo Go only contains the native modules Expo chose to bundle. This app needs
Google Sign-In (decisions.md D3), expo-secure-store for the session JWT, and
expo-notifications for status pushes (D4) — none of which Expo Go can load. So
development happens against a custom dev client built by the 'development'
profile below, installed once on the test phone; after that `npm start` reloads
JS into it exactly like Expo Go would.
'preview' is what actually ships on Thursday: decisions.md D1 targets a
sideloaded APK, not a Play Store submission, so it builds an installable .apk
with production JS rather than an .aab.
